+"""Add business_id, industry, date_onboarded, client_status, first_lead_id, first_inquiry_id to clients.
+
+Revision ID: 0011_client_business_id
+Revises: 0015_named_constraints
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.client import Client
+
+
+revision = "0011_client_business_id"
+down_revision = "0015_named_constraints"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    # Add new columns
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("business_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("industry", sa.VARCHAR(120), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("date_onboarded", sa.DATE(), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("client_status", sa.VARCHAR(32), nullable=False, server_default="Active"))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_lead_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_inquiry_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+
+    # Create indexes
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients", ["business_id"], unique=True)
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients", ["industry"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients", ["client_status"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients", ["first_lead_id"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients", ["first_inquiry_id"])
+
+    # Backfill existing clients with business_id
+    conn = op.get_bind()
+    # Get all existing clients
+    existing_clients = conn.execute(sa.select(Client.id, Client.created_at).where(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))).fetchall()
+    for client_id, created_at in existing_clients:
+        # Extract year from created_at or use current year
+        year = created_at.year if created_at else 2026
+        # Generate business_id for each client
+        business_id = next_business_id(conn, "CLT", year)
+        conn.execute(
+            sa.update(Client)
+            .where(Client.id == client_id)
+            .values(business_id=business_id)
+        )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_inquiry_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_lead_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "client_status")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "date_onboarded")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "industry")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "business_id")

+import uuid
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
+from src.backend.core.roles import Role
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.admin_process import (
+    AdminProcessCreate,
+    AdminProcessListResponse,
+    AdminProcessRead,
+    AdminProcessUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services.admin_process_service import process_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/admin-processes", tags=["admin-processes"])
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=AdminProcessListResponse)
+def list_processes(
+    _: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+    q: str | None = None,
+) -> AdminProcessListResponse:
+    items, total, page, page_size = process_service.list_processes_service(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, q=q
+    )
+    return AdminProcessListResponse(
+        items=[AdminProcessRead.model_validate(p) for p in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=AdminProcessRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_process(
+    body: AdminProcessCreate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+) -> AdminProcessRead:
+    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
+
+    try:
+        process = process_service.create_process_service(db, body, current_user.id)
+        return AdminProcessRead.model_validate(process)

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.drn import DocType, DocumentNature, DRNStatus, IntendedUser
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.drn import (
+    DRNListResponse,
+    DRNRead,
+    DRNUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services import drn_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["drn"])
+
+
+@router.post("/drns", response_model=DRNRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_drn(
+    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
+    doc_type: str = Form(...),
+    date: str = Form(...),
+    associated_project_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    associated_token_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    author_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    document_nature: str = Form(DocumentNature.INTERNAL.value),
+    intended_user: str = Form(IntendedUser.INTERNAL.value),
+    description: str = Form(...),
+    revision: str = Form("R0"),
+    status: str = Form(DRNStatus.DRAFT.value),
+    remarks: str | None = Form(None),
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    if file and file.filename:
+        if len(file.file.read()) > drn_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+        file.file.seek(0)
+
+    try:
+        doc_type_enum = DocType(doc_type)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid doc_type. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocType)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        document_nature_enum = DocumentNature(document_nature)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid document_nature. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentNature)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        intended_user_enum = IntendedUser(intended_user)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid intended_user. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in IntendedUser)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    file_bytes = None
+    original_filename = None
+    if file and file.filename:
+        file_bytes = file.file.read()
+        original_filename = file.filename
+
+    project_id = uuid.UUID(associated_project_id) if associated_project_id else None
+    token_id = uuid.UUID(associated_token_id) if associated_token_id else None
+    author_uuid = uuid.UUID(author_id) if author_id else current_user.id
+
+    drn = drn_service.create_drn(
+        db=db,
+        doc_type=doc_type_enum.value,
+        date=datetime.fromisoformat(date),
+        associated_project_id=project_id,
+        associated_token_id=token_id,
+        author_id=author_uuid,
+        document_nature=document_nature_enum.value,
+        intended_user=intended_user_enum.value,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status_enum.value,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_bytes=file_bytes,
+        original_filename=original_filename,
+    )
+
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns", response_model=DRNListResponse)
+def list_drns(
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+    project_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    token_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    doc_type: str | None = Query(None),
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    project_uuid = uuid.UUID(project_id) if project_id else None
+    token_uuid = uuid.UUID(token_id) if token_id else None
+
+    items, total = drn_service.list_drns(
+        db,
+        project_id=project_uuid,
+        token_id=token_uuid,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        status=status,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+    return DRNListResponse(
+        items=[DRNRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def get_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.patch("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def update_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: DRNUpdate,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.update_drn(db, drn_id, **update_data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.delete("/drns/{drn_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    success = drn_service.delete_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+
+
+@router.post("/drns/{drn_id}/transition-status", response_model=DRNRead)
+def transition_status(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str = Form(...),
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    drn = drn_service.transition_status(db, drn_id, status_enum.value)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}/download")
+def download_file(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    file_path = drn_service.get_file_path(db, drn_id)
+    if not file_path:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found")
+
+    path = Path(file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type="application/octet-stream",
+        filename=f"drn_{drn_id}.file",
+    )

+"""Base CRUD service helper for HR bundle modules.
+
+Provides common CRUD operations for HR-related entities.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class BaseCRUDService(Generic[T]):
+    """Base CRUD service for HR entities."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repo_module):
+        self.repo = repo_module
+
+    def list_items(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+        q: str | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[list[T], int, int, int]:
+        """List items with pagination and search."""
+        items, total = self.repo.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def get_item(self, db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> T | None:
+        """Get item by ID."""
+        return self.repo.get_by_id(db, item_id)
+
+    def create_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T:
+        """Create item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.repo.create(db, **kwargs)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.create",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            after_json={
+                "id": str(item.id),
+                **self._get_audit_fields(item),
+            },
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def update_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T | None:
+        """Update item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return None
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if hasattr(item, key):
+                setattr(item, key, value)
+
+        self.repo.update(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.update",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def delete_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Delete item (soft delete) with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return False
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        self.repo.soft_delete(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.delete",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return True
+
+    def _get_entity_type(self) -> str:
+        """Get entity type for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return "item"
+
+    def _get_audit_fields(self, item: T) -> dict:
+        """Get fields for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return {"id": str(item.id)}

+"""Local filesystem storage helper for DRN files.
+
+Provides file upload, retrieval, and deletion utilities for DRN documents.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Save a file for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code (e.g., SWA-2025-DBR-001)
+        original_name: Original filename
+        file_bytes: File content as bytes
+
+    Returns:
+        Tuple of (file_path, mime_type)
+    """
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def get_file_path(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    """Get the full path for a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        Full file path or None if not found
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    return str(path) if path.exists() else None
+
+
+def delete_file(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> bool:
+    """Delete a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        True if file was deleted, False if it didn't exist
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    if path.exists():
+        path.unlink()
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def list_files(drn_code: str) -> list[str]:
+    """List all files for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+
+    Returns:
+        List of filenames
+    """
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    if not d.exists():
+        return []
+
+    return [f.name for f in d.iterdir() if f.is_file()]

+import uuid
+from datetime import date

+
+from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
+    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()
+
+
+def list_time_logs(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    employee_id: str | None = None,
+    work_type: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+    end_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
+    query = db.query(TimeLog)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
+        )
+
+    if employee_id:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)
+
+    if work_type:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)
+
+    if start_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)
+
+    if end_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
+    db.add(time_log)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        setattr(time_log, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
+    db.delete(time_log)
+    db.commit()

@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def create_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    doc_type: str,
+    date: datetime,
+    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    document_nature: str = "Internal",
+    intended_user: str = "Internal",
+    description: str = "",
+    revision: str = "R0",
+    status: str = "Draft",
+    remarks: str | None = None,
+    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
+    original_filename: str | None = None,
+) -> DRN:
+    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)
+
+    file_path = None
+    if file_bytes and original_filename:
+        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)
+
+    drn = DRN(
+        drn_code=drn_code,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        date=date,
+        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
+        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
+        author_id=author_id,
+        document_nature=document_nature,
+        intended_user=intended_user,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_path=file_path,
+    )
+    db.add(drn)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def list_drns(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
+    status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
+    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)
+
+    if project_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
+    if token_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
+    if doc_type:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
+    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()
+
+
+def update_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    **kwargs,
+) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    for key, value in kwargs.items():
+        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(drn, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return False
+
+    drn.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    drn.status = new_status
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+    return drn.file_path

+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CLOSED: {

+        agreement_id=agreement_id,

+        description=description,
+        token_status=token_status or TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
+        tokens_used=tokens_used,
+        swa_team_lead=swa_team_lead,
+        project_owner=project_owner,
+        client_employee_name=client_employee_name,
+        client_employee_email=client_employee_email,
+        notes=notes,
+    )
+
+    db.add(token)
+    db.flush()
+
+    token.token_id = next_business_id(db, "TKN", current_year)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.create",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=created_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "agreement_id": str(agreement_id),
+            "token_type": token_type,
+            "token_status": token.token_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(tokens_used) if tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_token(db: Session, token_id: uuid.UUID) -> Token | None:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.id == token_id).first()
+
+
+def list_tokens(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Token], int]:
+    query = db.query(Token)
+
+    if agreement_id:
+        query = query.filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id)
+
+    if token_status:
+        query = query.filter(Token.token_status == token_status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def update_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: dict,
+    updated_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    for key, value in update_data.items():
+        if hasattr(token, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(token, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    if old_status != token.token_status:
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="token.status_transition",
+            entity_type="token",
+            entity_id=token.id,
+            user_id=updated_by,
+            after_json={
+                "token_id": token.token_id,
+                "from_status": old_status,
+                "to_status": token.token_status,
+            },
+        )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def delete_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    deleted_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return False
+
+    token_status = token.token_status
+    if token_status not in {TokenStatus.CANCELLED, TokenStatus.CLOSED}:
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Cannot delete token with status '{token_status}'. "
+            "Only 'Cancelled' or 'Closed' tokens can be deleted."
+        )
+
+    db.delete(token)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.delete",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token_id,
+        user_id=deleted_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "token_status": token_status,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_token_status(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    transitioned_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    if not can_transition_status(token.token_status, new_status):
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Invalid status transition from '{token.token_status}' to '{new_status}'"
+        )
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    token.token_status = new_status
+
+    if new_status == TokenStatus.CLOSED and token.tokens_used:
+        agreement = (
+            db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+            .filter(ServiceAgreement.id == token.agreement_id)
+            .first()
+        )
+        if agreement:
+            agreement.total_tokens = (
+                (agreement.total_tokens or 0) + float(token.tokens_used)
+            )
+            db.commit()
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.status_transition",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=transitioned_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "from_status": old_status,
+            "to_status": new_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(token.tokens_used) if token.tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_tokens_by_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Token]:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id).all()

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, func

class EmployeeRoleCode(StrEnum):
    AE = "AE"
    SE = "SE"
    RE = "RE"
    PM = "PM"
    AUD = "AUD"
    HR = "HR"
    MKT = "MKT"
    FOUNDER = "FOUNDER"


class EmploymentStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "Active"
    EXITED = "Exited"
    ON_LEAVE = "On Leave"


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False
    )
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)

    employee_business_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        String(64), nullable=True, unique=True, index=True
    )
    employee_role_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=True, index=True)
    department: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True, index=True)
    date_of_joining: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    date_of_exit: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    employment_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(20),
        nullable=False,
        default=EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE.value,
        server_default=EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE.value,
    )
    location: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=True)
    reporting_manager_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )

    reporting_manager: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        "User",
        remote_side=lambda: [User.id],
        foreign_keys=lambda: [User.reporting_manager_id],
    )

def list_users_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_users(db, page, page_size, q, role, is_active)
    return items, total, page, page_size


def create_user_service(db: Session, data: UserCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> User:
    password_hash = hash_password(data.password)
    employee_business_id = next_business_id(db, "EMP")
    user = create_user(db, data.email, data.name, password_hash, data.role.value, employee_business_id)

    if data.employee_role_code is not None:
        user.employee_role_code = data.employee_role_code.value
    if data.department is not None:
        user.department = data.department
    if data.date_of_joining is not None:
        user.date_of_joining = data.date_of_joining
    if data.employment_status is not None:
        user.employment_status = data.employment_status.value
    if data.location is not None:
        user.location = data.location
    if data.reporting_manager_id is not None:
        user.reporting_manager_id = data.reporting_manager_id
    update_user(db, user)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.create",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "id": str(user.id),
            "email": user.email,
            "name": user.name,
            "role": user.role,
            "employee_business_id": user.employee_business_id,
        },
    )

    return user


def get_user_service(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return get_by_id(db, user_id)


def update_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: UserUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
    is_self: bool = False,
) -> User | None:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return None

    before_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "employee_role_code": user.employee_role_code,
        "department": user.department,
        "employment_status": user.employment_status,
        "location": user.location,
        "reporting_manager_id": str(user.reporting_manager_id) if user.reporting_manager_id else None,
    }

    if data.name is not None:
        user.name = data.name
    if data.role is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.role = data.role.value
    if data.is_active is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.is_active = data.is_active
    if data.employee_role_code is not None:
        user.employee_role_code = data.employee_role_code.value
    if data.department is not None:
        user.department = data.department
    if data.date_of_joining is not None:
        user.date_of_joining = data.date_of_joining
    if data.date_of_exit is not None:
        user.date_of_exit = data.date_of_exit
    if data.employment_status is not None:
        user.employment_status = data.employment_status.value
    if data.location is not None:
        user.location = data.location
    if data.reporting_manager_id is not None:
        user.reporting_manager_id = data.reporting_manager_id

    update_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "employee_role_code": user.employee_role_code,
        "department": user.department,
        "employment_status": user.employment_status,
        "location": user.location,
        "reporting_manager_id": str(user.reporting_manager_id) if user.reporting_manager_id else None,
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.update",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return user


def soft_delete_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return False

    before_json = {
        "deleted_at": None,
    }

    soft_delete_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "deleted_at": str(user.deleted_at),
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.delete",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return True

"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.boq_parser import parse_excel, parse_json
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import create_boq, get_next_version_number

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/boqs")
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10MB
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".json"}


def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID) -> Path:
    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, file_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    d = _ensure_dir(project_id)
    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{file_name}"
    path = d / safe_name
    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
    return str(path)


def upload_boq(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file_bytes: bytes,
    file_name: str,
    content_type: str | None,
    parsed_by: uuid.UUID | None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 10MB limit")

    ext = Path(file_name).suffix.lower()
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}")

    if ext == ".xlsx":
        items = parse_excel(file_bytes)
    else:
        items = parse_json(file_bytes)

    if not items:
        raise ValueError("No valid line items found in file")

    file_path = _save_file(project_id, file_name, file_bytes)
    version_number = get_next_version_number(db, project_id)

    boq = create_boq(
        db=db,
        project_id=project_id,
        version_number=version_number,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        parsed_by=parsed_by,
        items=items,
        notes=notes,
    )

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="boq.upload",
        entity_type="boq",
        entity_id=boq.id,
        user_id=parsed_by,
        after_json={
            "project_id": str(project_id),
            "version_number": version_number,
            "file_name": file_name,
            "items_count": len(items),
        },
    )

    return {
        "id": boq.id,
        "project_id": boq.project_id,
        "version_number": boq.version_number,
        "file_name": boq.file_name,
        "file_path": boq.file_path,

"""Wave 9 / Agent Epsilon — Project Tracking module tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def _create_client(authed_admin_client, code: str = "PTC-001", name: str = "PTClient") -> str:
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/clients",
        json={"name": name, "code": code, "primary_email": f"{code.lower()}@example.com"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()["id"]


async def test_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="BIZ-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "BizProj",
            "code": "BP-001",
            "status": "Lead",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    assert body["business_id"] == f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-001"
    assert body["milestone"] == "Concept"


async def test_business_id_increments(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="INC-001")
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    ids = []

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.user import User


def get_by_email(db: Session, email: str) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.email == email, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_id(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    query = db.query(User).filter(User.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(User.email.ilike(search) | User.name.ilike(search))

    if role:
        query = query.filter(User.role == role)

    if is_active is not None:
        query = query.filter(User.is_active == is_active)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(User.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(
    db: Session,
    email: str,
    name: str,
    password_hash: str,
    role: str,
    employee_business_id: str | None = None,
) -> User:
    user = User(
        email=email,
        name=name,
        password_hash=password_hash,
        role=role,
        employee_business_id=employee_business_id,
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def update(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def soft_delete(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime

    user.deleted_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user

import uuid
from datetime import date
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog


def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()


def list_time_logs(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    employee_id: str | None = None,
    work_type: str | None = None,
    start_date: date | None = None,
    end_date: date | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
    query = db.query(TimeLog)

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
        )

    if employee_id:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)

    if work_type:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)

    if start_date:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)

    if end_date:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
    db.add(time_log)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(time_log)
    return time_log


def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
    for key, value in data.items():
        setattr(time_log, key, value)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(time_log)
    return time_log


def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
    db.delete(time_log)
    db.commit()

from collections.abc import Generator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker

from src.backend.core.config import settings

engine = create_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True, future=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autoflush=False, autocommit=False, expire_on_commit=False, bind=engine)


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

import uuid
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

import structlog
from fastapi import Request, Response
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware

logger = structlog.get_logger()


class RequestIdMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(
        self, request: Request, call_next: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response]]
    ) -> Response:
        request_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-ID", str(uuid.uuid4()))
        response = Response(status_code=200)
        response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id

        structlog.contextvars.clear_contextvars()
        structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars(request_id=request_id)

        logger.info("request_start", method=request.method, path=request.url.path)

        try:
            result = await call_next(request)
            response = result
            response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
            logger.info(
                "request_end",
                method=request.method,
                path=request.url.path,
                status_code=response.status_code,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(
                "request_error", method=request.method, path=request.url.path, error=str(e)
            )
            raise

        return response

display.text:
from collections.abc import Callable
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.roles import Role, role_includes
from src.backend.core.security import decode_token
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User

security_scheme = HTTPBearer()


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
) -> User:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(creds.credentials)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired token") from e
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Wrong token type")
    user = get_by_id(db, UUID(payload["sub"]))
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
    return user


def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user

    return _checker

import uuid
from datetime import date
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog


def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()


def list_time_logs(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    employee_id: str | None = None,
    work_type: str | None = None,
    start_date: date | None = None,
    end_date: date | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
    query = db.query(TimeLog)

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
        )

    if employee_id:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)

    if work_type:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)

    if start_date:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)

    if end_date:
        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
    db.add(time_log)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(time_log)
    return time_log


def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
    for key, value in data.items():
        setattr(time_log, key, value)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(time_log)
    return time_log


def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
    db.delete(time_log)
    db.commit()
